name: Rorima! ~Chiccha na Mama to no H na Seikatsu~
original_name: ろりま！～ちっちゃなママとのHな生活～
source:
Main character's sister attends college in Tokyo while living alone, but he is not really motivated to study in preparatory school. But one night he sees a wet dream about his mother. She accepts his feelings as she can not endure living alone either...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
